_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_JY).

levels.name: Platform level: platform 1 (edge platform by the Matkakeskus), island platform 2/4, island platform 3, bus terminal side
levels.name_source: Väylävirasto, "Ratapihaselvitykset: Jyväskylä" (Väyläviraston julkaisuja 53/2026, published 2026-08-10, CC BY 4.0), pp. 28 and 31–32, https://www.doria.fi/bitstream/handle/10024/195297/vj_2026-53_978-952-405-430-0.pdf?sequence=5&isAllowed=y, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0) via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-JY/_report.json and jyvaskyla_platform_vayla.geojson, read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Upper level: Matkakeskus hall with the shops and restaurants, and the overpass over the tracks to Lutakko (Messusilta)
levels.name_source: OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-JY.json), read 2026-10-30; Visit Jyväskylä Region, "Matkakeskus", https://visitjyvaskyla.fi/saapuminen/matkakeskus/, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jyv%C3%A4skyl%C3%A4_Central_Station, read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_JY).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 6 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_JY).

1._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.3230137, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 449 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
